name: XCMG PCR300 demolition robot
summary: Two-tonne demolition robot that XCMG launched at bauma China 2024; the maker claims the demolition power of a six-tonne excavator, with breaker, shovel, grab and shear attachments.

germany.statusNote: Only trade-fair coverage from bauma China 2024 found; no XCMG product page, European dealer or price for the PCR300.
